note: The public identity for regular-season team forecasts (P240). Every number it publishes is produced by the two ALREADY-EVALUATED private engines it names in derivedFrom — nothing here is a new fit, a re-fit, or a promotion. Promotion to any stronger label belongs exclusively to the frozen walk-forward contract (regular-season-evaluation-contract.json) and its own receipts; this card cannot satisfy that contract and does not claim to.

derivedFrom.role: win/margin/total heads: elo-logistic win probability over cutoff Elo, analytic normal margin and total, params frozen at the committed evaluation (train 2023-24, held-out 2025)
the joint score simulation those heads are published through; its consistency receipt pins sim == analytic within 0.0001

separateFrom: nfl-preseason-public-beta-v1 — the preseason identity and its coin-flip honest limit describe PRESEASON games only; the two identities never merge (the preseason-model-card precedent). Preseason games keep the preseason path and its abstentions.

plainEnglish.what: A simulated score range and win chance for every regular-season NFL game, generated from a team-strength rating (Elo) that has watched three seasons of finals, and frozen before kickoff.
plainEnglish.honestLimit: Tested on a full held-out 2025 season this model picked about 64% of winners (log loss 0.6478 against a coin's 0.6931). It has NOT been shown to beat the sportsbook market, and its 2026 walk-forward evaluation starts at Week 1 under bars that were frozen in August — until that sample accumulates, every forecast is experimental.
plainEnglish.whatItIsGoodFor: An honest, reproducible pre-kickoff baseline: which side is likelier, by how much, and how wide the range really is (80% score intervals covered 80.15% on held-out 2025 regular-season games).
plainEnglish.whyPublishItAtAll: The frozen evaluation contract requires pre-kickoff forecasts-of-record to exist before any of them can be judged. Publishing them, clearly labeled, is how the record accumulates without a single number being backfilled.

trainedOn: 2023-2024 regular + postseason finals (570 observations); Elo state advances chronologically through every non-preseason final since, with one-third regression to the mean at each season boundary — the exact protocol the receipts describe.
nextReview: under the frozen 2026 walk-forward contract: first reading at 64 decisive games and 4 completed weeks, no promotion in either direction before that
